children: Nebula by Titan, the luxury gold watch brand under Titan Company Limited, launched its first exclusive standalone boutique in Khar, Mumbai, on Wednesday, marking the brand’s most significant retail investment to date. Filmmaker Karan Johar and actor Karisma Kapoor inaugurated the boutique.

Spread across approximately 2,000 sq. ft., the store is the first dedicated Nebula outlet and the first exclusive brand boutique within Titan’s Premium Collection portfolio. It carries the brand’s range of 18K gold timepieces and offers personalised consultation services.
Interiors inspired by Indian heritage and design

The boutique’s interiors draw on four design themes — celestial elements, gardens, architecture, and historic Indian cities — executed through handcrafted brass and wood balusters, marquetry, gold leafing and patterned flooring. The dominant colour palette pairs indigo with antique gold and ivory accents.

Kalpana Rangamani, Chief Sales and Marketing Officer for Premium and Luxury Watches at Titan, said the boutique represents “the physical expression of the Nebula brand” and reflects growing consumer demand for luxury products rooted in Indian craftsmanship and cultural identity.

Located in one of Mumbai’s established fashion and retail corridors, the outlet positions Nebula alongside international luxury brands competing for India’s expanding high-net-worth consumer base. Titan has not disclosed the project’s capital investment or announced timelines for additional boutique openings.

title: Titan’s Nebula opens first standalone boutique in Mumbai’s Khar
